shorts_extract.hook: Every time you bang your shin and rub it, you trigger a 100-meter-per-second nerve race that slams a gate inside your spine before pain reaches your brain.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Melzack & Wall (1965 Science) spinal dorsal-horn Gate Control + Wall & Sweet self-tested TENS + Duan et al. (2015 Cell) dynorphin interneuron proof.
shorts_extract.twist: Why cutting spinal nerves made phantom pain worse, why anxious staring opens the gate from above, and how to close your gate from both ends.
